summary: Starfield Script Extender (SFSE) plugin providing direct HOTAS/HOSAS ship flight control via native DirectInput HID polling. Features an in-game ImGui binding wizard, per-axis inversion and sensitivity, 22 configurable ship action button bindings, digital axis emulation, and live config reload — no vJoy or Joystick Gremlin required.

projects/AbsoluteHOTAS.purpose: Core plugin code including the main entry point, hooks, controller thread, and default configuration ini.

subdirectories.src: C++ source files implementing Main, low-level throttle hooks, and DirectInput controller.
subdirectories.include: C++ header files containing class declarations and struct definitions.

shared.purpose: Common headers, global variables, and utilities shared within the project.

subdirectories.src: Global variable definitions, plugin info details, and runtime paths/logs configuration.
subdirectories.include: Common headers, precompiled header (PCH.h), DirectInput/KBM utilities, and global synchronization variables.

docs.purpose: Technical documentation containing flight control cluster memory maps, hardware specifications, and output scancode reference charts.

projects/AbsoluteHOTAS/src/Main.cpp.purpose: Defines SFSEPluginLoad which initializes log paths, sets up a vectored exception handler for crash monitoring, and installs the low-level memory writer hooks via ThrottleHook.

projects/AbsoluteHOTAS/src/ThrottleHook..purpose: Handles AOB signature scanning inside the game's .text section, allocates 2GB-near memory trampolines, hooks the critical flight writer path, registers manual camera/rotational gates, and provides safe override logic for ship roll, pitch, and yaw.

projects/AbsoluteHOTAS/src/ThrottleContr.purpose: Manages the execution thread of the DirectInput controller, normalizes and deadzones axis inputs, and delegates processing to specific subsystems.

projects/AbsoluteHOTAS/src/SignalHunter..purpose: Runs the 'Signal Hunter' algorithm to locate the dynamic control cluster, performs throttle injection, and manages reverse thrust and boost zones.

projects/AbsoluteHOTAS/src/ShipOutput.cp.purpose: Handles ref-counted holding state for specific ship buttons/actions, resolving overlapping commands and translating them to KBM injects.

projects/AbsoluteHOTAS/src/AimController.purpose: Drives the source-object reticle/cursor via DirectInput axes or buttons independently from steering, including HOSAM alignment assist logic.

projects/AbsoluteHOTAS/config/AbsoluteHO.purpose: Provides user-definable mapping settings for flight axes, gain parameters, physical button assignments, custom scancodes, and idle deadzones.

flight_control_cluster.base_register: RDI (captured from execution stream of the writer block)
flight_control_cluster.base_pointer_source: R13 (upstream source object for processed intent)

memory_lanes.cluster_base + 0x58: Signed Roll / Lateral Output Lane (Float, -1.0 to +1.0)
memory_lanes.cluster_base + 0x68: Signed Throttle Target / Reverse-Capable Throttle Lane (Float, 0.0 to 1.0 or signed)

validation_heuristics.corroboration: Ensuring the read float values are finite, reasonable, and adjacent lanes scale together under isolated inputs.

shipping_paradigm.standalone_mode: The mod compiles into AbsoluteHOTAS.dll and AbsoluteHOTAS.ini. Legacy scripting components (Papyrus, .esm, quest seat-trackers) have been removed from the release path, ensuring direct and standalone flight controller execution on DLL load.

how_to_add_new_ship_action.ini_config: Add new i<Action>Button under [ShipButtons] and s<Action>Output under [ShipButtonOutputs] in projects/AbsoluteHOTAS/config/AbsoluteHOTAS.ini.
how_to_add_new_ship_action.controller_declaration: Update ThrottleController::Config struct in projects/AbsoluteHOTAS/include/ThrottleController.h to include the new bindings.
how_to_add_new_ship_action.config_parsing: Add standard BindingDef in projects/AbsoluteHOTAS/src/ThrottleController.cpp inside LoadShipButtonBindings to map the actionId, INI key, and output string key.
how_to_add_new_ship_action.default_output: Register default action scancode in DefaultShipOutputForAction inside projects/AbsoluteHOTAS/src/ThrottleController.cpp.
how_to_add_new_ship_action.state_update: Update state evaluation in UpdateShipButtonBindings to check physical press and trigger SetOutputHeld/PulseOutput.

how_to_adjust_axis_normalization_or_reve.variables: Change configuration mappings in LoadConfig (detents, idle plateaus, reverse threshold) and adjust matching variables in include/ThrottleController.h.

how_to_update_writer_block_hooks_for_gam.signature_update: Verify assembly signature in InstallRotationalGates and raw Pattern structs in projects/AbsoluteHOTAS/src/ThrottleHook.cpp.
how_to_update_writer_block_hooks_for_gam.call_rva_update: Adjust version constant bounds and target displacement search bounds (e.g. 0x12B0000 to 0x12C0000 range check in ThrottleHook.cpp line 817).
